content.title: Artificial Memory Prosthesis — Toy Model
content.summary: Software-only toy simulation of a provenance-aware external episodic memory store with a simulated BCI cue interface, similarity retrieval, and encoding/retrieval impairment controls.
content.core_hypothesis: An external episodic memory store, accessed through an assistive interface, may help surface contextual information when biological recall is impaired; this is a research hypothesis, not a demonstrated clinical effect.
design: episodic records with timestamp, person, event, place, details, confidence and source
human confirmation required before treating retrieval candidates as true
content.source_relationship: Inspired at a high level by the user's uploaded MemBank paper's external memory, content-addressing and retrieval ideas; does not implement neural activation pointers or HGNS.
limitations: no neural signal acquisition or decoding
no Alzheimer's pathology model or clinical validation
cannot recover events that were never captured
not a medical device or treatment
